chapter.2.sub: Scouts chart the Goblin Cave and the Ancient Ruins
chapter.3.title: Chapter III · The Emerald Depths
chapter.3.sub: Glowing caverns open in the northwest wilds
chapter.4.title: Chapter IV · Trial of Ember Peak
chapter.4.sub: A bustling city faces the Elder Dragon of the mountain

talk.m.broodMother: Welcome to my crystal web, little prey!
talk.m.elderDragon: Mortals! Kneel before the ancient flame!
talk.m.demon: Your souls belong to the pit!
talk.m.demonLord: This realm shall fall to darkness!
talk.h.boss.goblinChief: Your raiding days end here, Chief!
talk.h.boss.broodMother: Cut through the webs—strike the Queen!
talk.h.boss.elderDragon: Raise your shields! Face the Elder Dragon!
talk.h.boss.demonLord: For every soul in town—this ends now!
talk.h.spring: Cool elf-spring water! Wounds are fading!
talk.h.altar: The ancient altar's blessing fills us with strength!
talk.h.rescue: You're safe now—head back to town!
skit.lazy.b: Resting my eyes is serious work!
skit.lazy.c: Haha, don't let the mayor catch you!
skit.job.farm.a: The soil feels rich and warm today.
skit.job.farm.b: Save me a fresh loaf at harvest, {a}!
skit.job.wood.b: Just in time for the new roofs, {a}.
skit.job.mine.a: My pickaxe struck a bright vein today!
skit.lunch.a: Nothing beats warm stew at noon.
skit.lunch.b: And a cold mug at the tavern tonight!
skit.drink.b: Haha, the whole street is spinning!
skit.wedding.a: With you for all my days, {b}.
skit.wedding.c: Look—the whole town came to bless us!
skit.spouse.0.b: As long as we have dinner together, {a}.
skit.spouse.0.c: I saved your favourite sweet apples!
skit.spouse.1.a: Remember when we first built our home?
skit.parent.a: Little {child} is growing up so fast!
skit.parent.b: Soon {child} will be taller than us.
skit.parent.c: Let them play carefree a little longer!
skit.youth.b: I'll work hard and make the town proud!
skit.elder.a: When I was young, this was all wild forest.
skit.elder.c: Aye—now look how lively our home has grown!
skit.kidHero.0.a: Are there really dragons in the dungeon?
skit.kidHero.0.b: Wait till I bring you back a dragon scale!
skit.kidHero.mage.a: Can you show me real magic, {b}?
skit.kidHero.mage.c: Amazing! I want to be a hero too!
skit.townHero.0.c: Tonight's tavern ale is on the town!
skit.townHero.gear.b: Your blacksmith's craft saved my life!
skit.event.fire.a: Thank goodness we put that fire out!
skit.event.fire.b: Everyone grabbed a water bucket in time.
skit.event.raid.b: Good thing our heroes held the gate.
skit.event.build.a: Heard the mayor plans a {building} next.
skit.event.build.b: Better gather more timber and stone!
skit.era.camp.a: A few more roofs and this'll be a true village.
skit.era.camp.b: I'm just glad the campfire keeps us warm.
skit.era.dungeon.b: The guild's party is already marching out!
skit.era.emerald.a: Scouts found glowing green crystals in the northwest!
skit.era.emerald.b: Pray the party watches out for giant webs.
skit.era.ember.a: You can see the glow of Ember Peak from the roofs!
skit.era.ember.b: Only true champions dare wake the Elder Dragon.
skit.era.towerFight.a: Look at the lightning over the Dark Tower!
skit.era.towerFight.b: Our heroes are fighting inside right now!
skit.era.towerFight.c: Everyone pray for their safe return!
skit.era.victoryHero.a: The whole realm owes you its peace, {b}!
skit.era.victoryHero.b: Protecting this lively town was worth every scar, {a}.
skit.era.victoryKid.a: Take that, Demon Lord! Swish, slash!
skit.era.victoryKid.b: Haha, great form! Future champion right there!
skit.era.victoryKid.c: I'm gonna be strong just like {b}!
skit.era.darkTower.a: Dark clouds are swirling over the Dark Tower…
skit.era.darkTower.b: Do you think our heroes can defeat the Demon Lord?
skit.era.darkTower.c: We'll keep the town strong until they return!
skit.era.victory.a: Still feels like a dream—the Demon Lord is gone.
skit.era.victory.b: Peace at last… let's bring flowers to the statue.
skit.era.victory.c: Their names will be sung for generations!
skit.season.spring.a: Warm spring breeze! The sprouts are out.
skit.season.spring.b: Here's to a rich harvest this year!
skit.season.summer.a: The river is silver with fish today!
skit.season.summer.b: Save a shady spot on the bank for me!
skit.season.autumn.b: Can't wait for the lanterns tonight!
skit.season.winter.a: Brrr! Frost on every roof this morning.
skit.season.winter.b: Stay close to the fire after work, {a}.
log.founded: A lone settler lights a campfire in the clearing.
log.foodShort: The larder is empty. Nobody new will settle here.
log.sowing: Sowing day: the fields are seeded for the year.
log.fishingContest: The summer fishing contest! Lines go in at the river bank.
log.fishingWinner: {name} lands the biggest fish and wins the contest.
log.solstice: Midwinter night: candles in every window, lanterns over the square.
log.blizzard: A blizzard! Nobody leaves the house today.
log.fishing: The summer fishing contest! Lines go in at the river bank.
log.wedding: {a} and {b} are married in the chapel.
log.grownUp: {name} has grown up and joins the workers.
log.tierUp: The settlement has grown into a {tier}!
log.dungeonFound: Scouts report the {dungeon} beyond the fields.
log.dungeonSpring: {leader}'s party drinks from a glowing elf-spring and recovers!
log.dungeonAltar: {leader}'s party receives the blessing of an ancient war altar!
log.dungeonRescue: {leader}'s party rescues a lost explorer (+{gold} gold)!
log.bossRetreat: {leader}'s party turns back at the gates of the {dungeon}'s master.
log.knockedOut: {name} is badly wounded. {leader} orders a retreat.
log.partyReturns: {leader}'s party returns from floor {floor} with {gold} gold.
log.raidRepelled: The {monster} are driven off. {gold} gold recovered.
log.raidWon: The {monster} ransack the town and burn the {building}.
log.raidWonNoDamage: The {monster} loot the stores and flee.
log.caravanArrives: A merchant caravan rolls in to trade at the market ({gold} gold).
log.fireStart: Fire! The {building} is burning. Fetch water!
log.fireOut: The fire at the {building} is out.
log.victory: {leader}'s party has slain the Demon Lord! Heroes of the realm: {names}.
log.nemesisSlain: {leader}'s party avenges their defeat and slays the Nemesis {monster} (+{gold} gold)!
log.abyssBossSlain: {leader}'s party conquers Abyss Floor {floor} and defeats {monster}!
log.siegeIncoming: A Giant Siege! {boss} leads {count} {monster} against the walls!
log.siegeRepelled: The Giant Siege is crushed! {boss} falls and {gold} gold is recovered!
talk.m.nemesis: Remember me?! Back for another beating?!
talk.m.siege: SMASH THE WALLS! CRUSH THE KEEP!
skit.era.abyss.a: Our heroes reached Floor {floor} of the Endless Abyss beneath the Tower!
skit.era.abyss.b: Nothing in the realm can stop them now!
skit.visitor.circus.a: Did you see the fire-breather at the circus tent?!
skit.visitor.circus.b: The flames lit up the whole square!
skit.visitor.alchemist.a: That traveling alchemist's potions are glowing like emeralds.
skit.visitor.alchemist.b: The adventurers swear a single sip makes their blades feel lighter!
skit.monument.a: Look at the boss trophies standing beside the square.
skit.monument.b: Every monument tells the story of how far our town has come.
log.heroBorn: A shooting star blessed the village: {name}, child of {parent}, was born bearing the Hero's mark!
log.heroAwakened: {name}, born and raised in our village, has come of age and awakened as the Chosen Hero!
log.heroSurvived: Protected by the Star of Destiny, {name} narrowly escaped death and retreated to town.
talk.kid.hero.1: I'll protect everyone when I grow up!
chapter.heroBorn.title: Star of the Village
chapter.heroBorn.sub: A child bearing the Hero's mark is born among the townsfolk
chapter.heroAwakened.title: The Chosen Hero Awakens
chapter.heroAwakened.sub: The village's child comes of age and takes up the Sunblade
